audit.loss_definition: Mean minibatch training loss over all optimizer updates in each learner round, sampled from replay. Not per-game or per-position losses.
audit.policy_definition: Mean softmax cross-entropy against self-play MCTS policy targets.
audit.value_definition: Mean squared error against final game-outcome targets in the player-to-move perspective.
audit.verification_limit: Verifies recorded losses against rounded console logs and code definitions; does not recompute historical training minibatches.
